basic_details.job_title: CSIR-NIIST Project JRF Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (CSIR-NIIST), Thiruvananthapuram, has invited online applications for one purely temporary Project JRF post (Post Code BBD-8, Molecular Biology and Biotechnology) at a stipend of Rs.37,000/- + 18% HRA. The essential qualification is an M.Sc in Biotechnology / Microbiology / Life Sciences with NET / GATE. The online link is open from 26 November 2026, 5.30 PM to 3 December 2026, 5.30 PM, through the CSIR-NIIST website.

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must apply online through the CSIR-NIIST website only, on the temporary position page at https://www.niist.res.in/opportunities-and-careers/temporary-position. No other mode of application will be accepted. The link is available from 26 November 2026, 5.30 PM to 3 December 2026, 5.30 PM.
Scanned copies of all certificates, including educational qualification, experience, age and community certificates.
Incomplete applications will not be entertained and will be summarily rejected.
important_instructions: Incomplete and late applications will not be considered. Bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, will disqualify the candidate. Interim enquiries will not be attended to.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NIIST Project JRF at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology
Project JRF (Post Code BBD-8, Subject Area: Molecular Biology and Biotechnology)
Thiruvananthapuram (Institute address: Industrial Estate PO, Pappanamcode, Thiruvananthapuram-695019)

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: CSIR-NIIST is an institute of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research, located at Industrial Estate PO, Pappanamcode, Thiruvananthapuram-695019. The notice is signed by the Controller of Administration. It invites applications for filling "purely temporary positions" through an online interview.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 35 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD and female candidates is as per GOI/CSIR Rules. The date for determining the upper age limit, qualification and experience is the closing date of the online application, 3 December 2026. Universities or institutes that award CGPA/SGPA/OGPA grades: candidates must convert them into percentage using the formula of their university/institute. Persons with Benchmark disabilities (PwBD) who fulfil the eligibility conditions prescribed under GOI instructions are encouraged to apply. For the full eligibility conditions, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc in Biotechnology / Microbiology / Life Sciences from recognized University or Equivalent WITH NET / GATE

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project JRF post carries a monthly stipend of Rs.37,000/- + 18% HRA. The post is purely temporary and is tenable till the duration of the project. The notice does not name the project or its funding agency. The notice adds that waitlisted candidates may be considered for any future project vacancies arising within a year from the date of interview, in the order of merit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-NIIST Project JRF
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must apply online through the CSIR-NIIST website only, on the temporary position page at https://www.niist.res.in/opportunities-and-careers/temporary-position . No other mode of application will be accepted. The link is available from 26 November 2026, 5.30 PM to 3 December 2026, 5.30 PM. Documents named in the notice: Scanned copies of all certificates, including educational qualification, experience, age and community certificates. Incomplete applications will not be entertained and will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A duly constituted Screening Committee will short-list candidates using its own criteria. Candidates should therefore mention in the application all qualifications and experience in the relevant area over and above the minimum prescribed qualification, supported with documents. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an online interview. The date and time of the online interview will be notified on www.niist.res.in in due course.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete and late applications will not be considered. Bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, will disqualify the candidate. Interim enquiries will not be attended to.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project JRF posts has CSIR-NIIST advertised?
faq.answer: CSIR-NIIST has advertised one Project JRF post (Post Code BBD-8, Molecular Biology and Biotechnology), printed as "One*" in Advt. No. PA/38/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR-NIIST Project JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date is 3 December 2026, 5.30 PM (Thursday). The online link opened on 26 November 2026 at 5.30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CSIR-NIIST Project JRF?
faq.answer: The qualification is an M.Sc in Biotechnology / Microbiology / Life Sciences from a recognized University or Equivalent, WITH NET / GATE.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSIR-NIIST Project JRF?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years, counted as on the closing date of online application, 3 December 2026. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD and female candidates is as per GOI/CSIR Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for the CSIR-NIIST Project JRF post?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs.37,000/- + 18% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for CSIR-NIIST Project JRF?
faq.answer: Apply online only through the CSIR-NIIST website, on the temporary position page. No other mode of application will be accepted.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for CSIR-NIIST Project JRF?
faq.answer: A Screening Committee short-lists candidates on its own criteria, and the shortlisted candidates are called for an online interview. The date and time will be notified on www.niist.res.in.

faq.question: Q8. Is the CSIR-NIIST Project JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a purely temporary position, tenable till the duration of the project. Waitlisted candidates may be considered for future project vacancies arising within a year from the date of interview, in order of merit.

faq.question: Q9. Can PwBD candidates apply for CSIR-NIIST Project JRF?
faq.answer: Yes, PwBD candidates fulfilling the eligibility conditions prescribed under GOI instructions are encouraged to apply.
